title: Slot version changes between read-back and commit
description: The scheduling source changes the slot version after the prepared action was read back and before the commit; the commit recheck must refuse the stale version.
callerVisible: The caller hears that the time is no longer available and is offered new options; no change is announced.
backendEvidence: Commit refused STATE_CHANGED on the before-state version
No effect for the stale version
notes: Added to the fixed fault registry for the follow-on prompt section 17 fault matrix. The LOCAL FIXTURE driver does not inject it (NOT_SUPPORTED); only the Layer-2 run tagged [FAULT:CHANGED_SLOT_DURING_CONFIRMATION] owned by WP-25 proves it.

registry.injectionPoint: the scheduling source changes the slot version between read-back and commit

postconditions: The commit is refused on the stale slot version and nothing is booked
A new commit needs a freshly prepared and confirmed action
